objective: Create a reproducible, physically bounded synthetic 775-motor dataset with run-isolated Edge Impulse splits.
acceptance_criteria: Synthetic records use the expected Edge Impulse features and labels.
No healthy or warning record crosses a critical current or vibration boundary.
Train, validation, and test outputs do not share run IDs.
non_goals: Do not claim synthetic data calibrates the physical motor.
Do not change firmware thresholds or sensor wiring.
